content.short: Renovating the Food chain. With IoT, Blockchain, AI & AR. We assure Quality from Farm to Food.
content.description: A decentralized supply chain tracking, traceability and transparency solution by the integration of Blockchain, AI, IoT and cloud technologies. We also intend to create franchises, online stores and cloud kitchens to deliver customers food, groceries, fruits and vegetables with 100% transparency and reliability while helping them visualize it using AR. We will adopt B2B, B2C & D2C business models.
